source.title: Axel Mellinger optical Milky Way / Stellarium bundled display texture
source.credit: Milky Way panorama: Axel Mellinger; bundled display texture: Stellarium contributors
source.grant: Specific bundled Milky Way panorama: modification and redistribution permitted with credit to Axel Mellinger.

processing: Historical optical Milky Way panorama; original bundled display PNG, with no pixel changes by Starward.
limitations: Low-resolution optical Milky Way display, not a general high-resolution survey or target-outskirts background.
Producer complete processing and scientific availability UNKNOWN; nominal J2000 orientation is not verified absolute astrometry.
No source exposure or scientific missing-data mask. Black display pixels do not establish zero brightness or missing observations.
Retained photographic structures and point sources are not independently selectable stars. Stellar identity remains in the separate catalogue; no stars or nebulae are erased.
